Copilot Projects: give your agents a rejection rule.

WHAT CHANGED
GitHub put Projects in public preview on October 28. Goals, context, agents and results can now live together in the Copilot app.

WHAT IT DOES
You describe the outcome, add the relevant material and choose tools and models. Copilot coordinates agents and returns work for review.

WHY BUILDERS SHOULD CARE
A creator brief can stay connected to its assets and drafts instead of disappearing across chats.

THE REAL-WORLD CHECK
In our earlier Tech Thursday session, Copilot CLI used MCP to generate a batch of images. The host rejected the visual direction. This was not a Projects demo. It's the lesson to carry into one: a completed task can still miss the brief.

TRY THIS WEEK
Create a project for three draft visuals, using a non-sensitive brief. Specify audience, subject, palette and composition. Add: 'Reject any result that misses one of these criteria. Return drafts for human review; do not publish.' Inspect every image yourself.

THE SIGNAL
AI is moving from answering a prompt to coordinating work. Your acceptance criteria belong in that workflow from the start.

Save this before your next agent brief.
